简介: Anton's first leading role was the Bafta nominated 'The most beautiful man in the world', the film was also awarded The Palme d'Or. His TV roles include the Emmy nominated Luther, the Bafta nominated Top Boy and most recently, Disney's Star Wars Andor. He can also be seen in some of the bigger studio movies: Dune: Part Two & Mission: Impossible - Dead Reckoning Part One
